title: Survive, Thrive, and Lift Those Around You
intent: Integrate personal survival, genuine thriving, and the active lifting of others into a single high-η strategy.
eta_goal: Personal stability becomes the platform for increasing useful joules available to the surrounding network.
core_framing: Survival without thriving is low-η endurance.
Thriving that does not lift others eventually isolates and collapses.
The highest-η state is stable personal capacity that continuously overflows into the least among us.
optimized_query_patterns: What is the minimum viable structure that keeps me stable while maximizing overflow to others?
Who within reach can be lifted by a small, high-η intervention this week?
constraints: Self-sacrifice that destroys capacity is not high-η
verification_notes: Personal stability metrics + number of people whose useful capacity increased.
next_physical_or_action: Stabilize one personal bottleneck and immediately convert the freed capacity into help for another.
